claim_a.claim_text: Anchor boxes of multiple scales and aspect ratios are essential for high-quality region proposals in dense feature maps.
claim_a.evidence_quote: Our scheme can be thought of as a pyramid of regression references ... we use 3 scales and 3 aspect ratios, yielding k=9 anchors at each sliding position.

claim_b.claim_text: Anchor-free per-pixel detection without any predefined anchor boxes outperforms anchor-based detectors and removes anchor hyperparameter tuning.
claim_b.evidence_quote: We propose a fully convolutional one-stage object detector (FCOS) to solve object detection in a per-pixel prediction fashion ... FCOS completely avoids the complicated computation related to anchor boxes ... and surpasses previous anchor-based one-stage detectors with the advantage of being much simpler.

rationale: FCOS directly contradicts the Faster R-CNN claim that anchor design is necessary for accurate detection; both make architectural recommendations and one supersedes the other on the same metric (COCO AP).
